## Summary and Motivation

Describe the change and link any relevant Aerium issue.

## Validation

List commands, results, tested platforms, and runtime checks. Explicitly state what was not tested.

## Risks and Compatibility

Describe effects on existing workflows, profiles, plugins, privacy, and upstream synchronization.

## AI Assistance

Disclose tools used and what they helped produce, or state that no AI assistance was used. Explain how the output was reviewed and validated.

## Checklist

- [ ] I understand the changes and have reviewed them for correctness.
- [ ] I have run relevant checks and disclosed validation gaps.
- [ ] I have checked licensing and preserved required attribution.
- [ ] I have not included credentials, personal data, or private recordings.
- [ ] I have read Aerium's contribution guidelines and Code of Conduct.
